name: Charles Borromeo
contribution: An Italian Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Milan from 1564 to 1584.
legacy: This person founded the Confraternity of Christian Doctrine and was a leading figure of the Counter-Reformation together with Ignatius of Loyola and Philip Neri.

checks.lead: Charles Borromeo (Italian: Carlo Borromeo; Latin: Carolus Borromeus; 2 October 1538 – 3 November 1584) was an Italian Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Milan from 1564 to 1584. He was made a cardinal in 1560.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
